review_candidates.title: Systems Engineer – Windows & MWARE Virtualisation
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Role Overview We are seeking a skilled Windows & VMware Engineer responsible for the administration, support, and optimisation of Microsoft Windows Server environments and VMware virtualisation platforms. Key Responsibilities Windows Server Administration Install, configure, and manage Microsoft Windows Server (2016/2019/2022). Administer Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and file services. Monitor server performance and troubleshoot system issues. VMware Virtualization Management Admin
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Hands-on knowledge of VMware, Nutanix, Dell HCI, and Dell storage platforms. 4–8 years of experience in Windows Server and VMware administration. Strong hands-on experience with: Windows Server 2016/2019/2022 Active Directory & Group Policy VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter Good understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, VLANs, firewalls). Qualifications & Certifications (Preferred) Microsoft Certified (e.g., Windows Server or Azure related) VMware VCP ITIL Foundation Relevant experience may be considered in lieu of formal certifications.
